status: unadopted proposal; no native collector/codec/guard qualification
scope: One complete RF01–RF06 invocation including old, candidate and resulting states, all touched properties, repeated observation/decoding and independent parity. Governing operation/group/transaction aggregate limits additionally apply.

accounting.states: Count each complete touched property state once for admission, including absent/deleted states; charge every repeated native state-row observation separately as work and buffer bytes.
accounting.nodes: Charge each native, candidate, reconstruction and repeated node occurrence, including orphan/cycle/duplicate observations. Identity caching cannot erase performed work.
accounting.payloads: Charge all scalar rows in scope including extra null/container/orphan payloads; collect independently of root reachability.
accounting.bytes: Charge original transport/native fields before retention, every artifact decode occurrence, full map/record slot identity and original source/token bytes. Shared immutable buffers reduce peak only with proven retained custody.
accounting.work: One unit per observed row, visited node, reference/slot check and allocation operation, plus one per byte hashed, decoded, encoded, copied or compared; sorting and collision scans charge all compared bytes. Charge more expensive codec operations under their selected profile as well.
accounting.memory: Reserve simultaneous old/candidate/new values, raw collection, exact lookup, traversal stacks, decoder scratch, output and diagnostics. The individual maxima do not promise simultaneous fit.
accounting.nativeTransport: Bound incremental collection and field decoding before full host allocation. Requesting N+1 rows detects overflow only when each returned field is independently bounded; a LIMIT alone does not bound bytes or prove complete scope.
accounting.aggregate: Retain governing operation/group/transaction charges across per-property calls, retries and internal finalization passes. Splitting a tree or resetting local counters cannot evade the enclosing bound.
accounting.deadline: Use minimum of stage and governing deadline, measured monotonically from invocation admission; native statements and codec work must be cancelable or contained.
accounting.failure: Refuse whole invocation with bounded diagnostics; roll back replacement and dependent key/history/group effects. Retain resource reservations until actual native/codec termination and transaction containment.

adoption: Select exact collector, bounded transport decoder, native statement/lock caps, codec work weights and memory-accounting adapter. Verify exact-limit/one-over, forced collision, concurrent peak and cancellation schedules before any support claim.
